description: H6. Prohibitions propagate downward and cannot be lifted. The child raises its own ceiling for exactly the category the company prohibits, and it changes nothing — and the refusal costs no allowance at any level.

requests.note: The child's exception permits 700.00 here. A prohibition is not a ceiling, so there is nothing for the child to outbid.
600.00 of a 600.00 ceiling. The meter was at zero after the refusal, not at 650.00 and not at anything in between.
And exhausted exactly on schedule, which is what pins the previous step to a measurement rather than an inequality.
